author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
everything_else_identical: generator, smoothing, seed 0, budget 96, ordering, gates, all six G10 thresholds

predeclared_outcome_met.criterion: if_zero_turn_fraction_falls_sharply -> the map was the dominant cause

what_this_establishes: The obstacle map, not string-pulling, was the dominant cause of straight routes. With walls and furniture largely absent from the map the scene looked like open space, and a shortest-path planner in open space produces straight lines. Representing the previously-unclassified 54% of cells cut the zero-turn fraction from 76% to 25%.

the_binding_constraint_has_moved.evidence: 10 of 96 candidates now satisfy the FULL long-horizon requirement and pass G3, G4 and G6. All 10 fail G5.
the_binding_constraint_has_moved.reading: every long-horizon-adequate route runs into geometry. The planner is still blind to obstacles the gate can see -- see F-G5-2.

consequence_for_turning_route_population.decision: NOT PREREGISTERED, and not justified as the next step
consequence_for_turning_route_population.why: It was proposed to fix straight routes. That problem is now largely explained by the map, and a turning population cannot help with what actually blocks admission: every route that already turns enough collides. Preregistering it now would target a constraint that is no longer binding.
consequence_for_turning_route_population.if_it_is_wanted_later: it remains a legitimate experiment, to be preregistered on its own terms once routes can be planned around real geometry

production_collection_status: BLOCKED. No admissible route exists in any scene, and the planner's obstacle map is known to omit solid geometry.
claim_boundary: This does not overwrite HOSPITAL_BO10_FROZEN_ROUTESET or OFFICE_BO10_FROZEN_ROUTESET.
Those remain valid measurements of what the pipeline produced under the old decode.
This is a separate measurement under a repaired decode, and it is not a turning-route experiment.
